varieties.title: Varieties
varieties.intro: A variety is a microgreen you grow by the tray and sell in 100 g boxes. This screen owns the numbers only — how long it takes, how much a tray yields, how much seed goes in — and works the price out from them. Every word a customer reads about it lives in content/varieties/[key].json.
varieties.introOps: Grow days sets the delivery date an ad-hoc order is promised. A tray's cost — its seed at the seed's own cost per 100 g, a share of a cocopeat block, and electricity and water — is spread over the tray's low yield to cost a 100 g box, and the margin below sets the price. So keep the low yield to what your trays actually cut: the sowing log shows it.
varieties.pickHint: Lowercase letters and hyphens only — radish, red-amaranth, green-amaranth. No numbers or spaces. This names the content file and the page address, so it is an identifier, not a label.
varieties.howTo: Save it here first, then create content/varieties/[key].json for the name and description and drop photos in public/img/varieties/[key]/. Until that file exists the variety is flagged below and stays off the site.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: There are three plans and there will only ever be three: Everyday Essentials, Rare & Exotic and Pick Your Own. They are defined by their content files in content/plans/, so this screen does not create or delete them — it sets what you tune. Price, box weight, order, and which varieties go in each of the four weeks.
plans.introRotation: A month is a rotation, not the same box four times. Week 1 carries the quick crops sown on the first Sunday and week 2 the slower ones sown that same Sunday (SPEC §5.2), so pick each week by grow days — the figure beside every variety in the list.

racks.title: Shelf racks
racks.intro: Racks with a steel shelf plate at every level. A price is calculated from what the rack is made of, never typed in — enter what the vendor charges for a shelf, a foot of angle, a bolt and a bush, and every rack below reprices itself from those figures. Racks made only of slotted angle, with no plates, are on Angle racks.
racks.introLayers: Three layers, and the split is what saves you the recalculation. Rates change often, so they live in one place. Build rules — four legs, eight bolt pairs a shelf, four bushes a rack — barely change. Racks on sale are the combinations you actually offer.
racks.introFrozen: Change a rate or a margin and every rack reprices itself immediately — all three ranges, no approval and nothing to accept row by row. A rack's price is never typed: it is always its cost plus its range's margin.
racks.seedBody: Loads the five shelf sizes and the ₹2 bolt and ₹5 bush you were quoted, plus the build rules and the one angle grade — 1.4 mm powder coat at ₹40 a foot, in orange, green and purple. Nothing already entered is overwritten, so this is safe to press twice.
racks.ratesTitle: Rates and build rules (vendor's prices, incl. GST)
racks.ratesHint: The top row is what parts cost. The rest is how a rack goes together, and only changes if the vendor changes how they supply it. Shelf count is not a setting — a rack has its height in feet, minus one. Saving any of these reprices every rack that uses it straight away — all three ranges, not just this screen. Nothing to approve and nothing to accept row by row.

angleRacks.title: Angle racks
angleRacks.intro: Racks built entirely from slotted angle, with no steel shelf plates. Same legs, same bolts and bushes, same heights — the only thing that changes is what a shelf is.
angleRacks.introRule: A shelf level is a rectangle of angle plus one more length down the middle, which braces the span and is where the LED tube mounts. So it is three lengths and two depths: a 4 × 1 ft level takes three 4 ft pieces and two 1 ft pieces, 14 running feet in all.
angleRacks.introShared: Bolt and bush prices, the build counts and the heights you sell are shared with Shelf racks — one set of rates, editable from either screen, so a vendor requote is still one edited number. Change any of them and every rack in all three ranges reprices itself immediately. The margin is this range's own and is set below.
angleRacks.ratesTitle: Rates this range is priced from
angleRacks.ratesHint: Shared with Shelf racks — one set of figures, so editing them here or there changes the same thing. Saving reprices every rack straight away, in all three ranges.
angleRacks.framesHint: The sizes you offer. No price and no load rating here, and both are deliberate: a frame is not a part the vendor sells, it is angle by the foot, and there is no deck to put a weight on. Length counts three times and depth twice, so a long shallow shelf costs more than a short deep one of the same area. Editing a depth or a length reprices every rack built on it at once.

pipeRacks.title: Pipe racks
pipeRacks.intro: Racks built from ¾ inch UPVC pipe, joined with four-way connectors. Light to move, nothing to rust, wipes clean — chosen for stability rather than for price, and it is the dearest of the three ranges.
pipeRacks.introRule: A shelf level is a rectangle of pipe — two lengths and two depths, and no middle rail. From 4 ft long it gets a leg under the middle of each long side instead, which is what holds the span up. Every junction takes a four-way connector, and every leg takes a bottom bush.
pipeRacks.introCost: The fittings are a large share of the price: every shelf level adds four connectors. So height is expensive here and depth is cheap, because a deeper shelf adds pipe without adding junctions.
pipeRacks.introShared: The four corner legs and the heights you sell are shared with the other ranges — edit them here or on Shelf racks, it is the same setting, and saving reprices every rack immediately. The pipe, connector and bush rates and the margin are this range's own, because nothing else uses them.
pipeRacks.ratesHint: The three material rates only this range uses, and underneath, the two shared settings it also depends on. Saving reprices every rack that uses them straight away — all three ranges, not just this screen. Nothing to approve and nothing to accept row by row.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.intro: Seed you hold and sell by the 100 g. This screen owns the numbers only — what 100 g costs us, the margin the sell price is worked out with, and how many grams are on the shelf. The grams are never shown to a customer. Every word a customer reads about a seed lives in content/seeds/[key].json.
seeds.introOps: Nothing on a row is typed. A seed is added with “+ New product” on a purchase bill, and its cost is the latest bill's, GST and shipping included — the bill number links to it. The grams held move by themselves: a bill adds them, a paid order or a sowing takes them, and the pencil beside them is for a stocktake. They are the limit — a customer can order up to what you hold, in 100 g packs, and under 100 g the seed shows as sold out. One order line caps at 20 packs (2 kg).

book.title: Book this parcel with {courier}?
book.confirm: {courier} creates the shipment and is asked to collect it on the date you picked. The charge comes out of the {courier} wallet.
book.retryConfirm: Only if you have checked the {courier} dashboard and this parcel is not there. If it is, booking again creates a second shipment and pays for it twice — copy its tracking number in below instead.
book.doneNoPickup: Booked — tracking {tracking}. The pickup request failed; ask for one in the courier's dashboard.
book.notReady: Book once the order is ready for delivery.
book.stuck: A booking was started {when} and never finished. The courier may have created the shipment: check its dashboard before booking again.
book.manual: Or enter a tracking number from the courier's dashboard

error.notBookable: This parcel cannot be booked now — the order must be ready for delivery and the parcel sent by courier.
error.stuck: A booking for this parcel was left unfinished. Reload the page.
error.raced: Someone else changed this order at the same moment. Reload the page and check before trying again.
error.noCourier: This courier's API keys are not set on the server, so it cannot be booked from here.
error.noPickup: This parcel's pickup is no longer on admin → delivery.
error.badDate: Pick a pickup date from today on.
error.courier: The courier refused the booking. Nothing was booked — fix the problem below and try again.
error.disabled: Booking is switched off on this server.

book.disabled: Booking from here is switched off on this server (COURIER_BOOKING). Book in the courier's dashboard and enter the tracking number below.

orders.gstStateFiled: No place of supply, and this quarter's GSTR-1 is marked filed — correct it with an amendment (GSTR-1A) on the portal.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: Checkout prices every order from our pickup below, except shelf racks, which ship from their maker (set on admin → racks). Microgreens, and everything else from our pickup in the same order, go on your own same-day run for the fixed fee. Every courier parcel pays the courier's live price for the weight worked out from the packing figures. Subscriptions pay no delivery. Until this is saved (and, for courier orders, a courier is connected), checkout shows no price and does not take payment.
delivery.statusNoToken: Delhivery is not connected. Set DELHIVERY_ENV and DELHIVERY_API_TOKEN in the environment.
delivery.statusNoSettings: Delhivery ({mode}) is connected. Save the pickup address and packing below to start quoting.
delivery.statusOk: Delhivery ({mode}) is working: 500 g within {pincode} quotes ₹{price, number}.
delivery.statusNoPickup: Delhivery does not collect from {pincode}. Check the pickup PIN.
delivery.unmeasuredHeading: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} not measured yet
delivery.unmeasuredHint: A courier order containing any of these can't be priced, so checkout won't take payment for it. Add the missing size or weight on its screen.
delivery.pickupHint: Where the courier collects parcels from. Never shown to customers.
delivery.greensHint: A fixed fee for any order with microgreens in it, whatever else rides along — they go on your own same-day run, not by courier. Set it from your average cost per drop and review it monthly.
delivery.packingHint: Order-wide figures for courier orders. Each tray's size and weight is set on its row in Trays & drainage. Racks pack two ways: a shelf rack is a stack of plates, each adding its plate's packed thickness (Shelf racks → plates); an angle or pipe rack is a bundle of legs and rails, measured by the angle's width and stacking (Shelf racks → angle rates) or the pipe's diameter (Pipe racks → rates). Grams per shelf is on each plate, frame and pipe size. Seeds are weighed by what's ordered, in 5 × 5 × 5 cm packets per 50 g.

field.seedPackingGrams: Seed box and padding, per order (g)

delivery.saved: Saved. Checkout uses these figures from now on.

errors.originId: A pickup row is damaged. Reload the page and try again.
errors.originMissing: That pickup was removed. Choose where this ships from now.
errors.originInUse: A vendor you removed is still the shelf-rack pickup. Choose another on admin → racks first.

delivery.angleGrade: {thickness, number} mm slotted angle — grams per foot

statusOtherOff.ekart: Ekart is not connected. Set EKART_CLIENT_ID, EKART_USERNAME and EKART_PASSWORD to add it to the checkout comparison.
statusOtherOff.shiprocket: Shiprocket is not connected. Set SHIPROCKET_EMAIL and SHIPROCKET_PASSWORD (the API user, not the account login) to add it to the checkout comparison.
statusOtherOff.velocity: Velocity is not connected. Set VELOCITY_API_KEY (dashboard → Settings → API Keys) to add it to the checkout comparison. Booking also needs VELOCITY_WAREHOUSES: each pickup's name mapped to its Velocity warehouse id.

delivery.statusOtherNoSettings: {courier} is connected. Save the pickup address below to start quoting.
delivery.statusOtherOk: {courier} is working: 500 g within {pincode} quotes from ₹{price, number} ({count, plural, one {# option} other {# options}}).
delivery.anglePacking: slotted angle width and stacking, in the angle rates on Shelf racks
delivery.pipePacking: pipe outer diameter, in the pipe rates
delivery.originsHint: Vendors who hand our customer's parcel straight to the courier — today only the shelf-rack maker, chosen on admin → racks. Never shown to customers. Register each address as a pickup location in your Delhivery, Ekart and Shiprocket accounts, and as a warehouse in Velocity (its id goes in VELOCITY_WAREHOUSES), before booking from it.
delivery.statusOriginNo: Delhivery does not collect from {name} ({pincode}). Check its PIN.
delivery.pipeWeight: pipe weight per foot, in the pipe rates

checkoutDelivery.notConfigured: Only you see this. No delivery fee is saved yet, so checkout can't price delivery. Customers see "not available right now" and can't pay.
checkoutDelivery.noCourier: Only you see this. Nothing in this cart is microgreens, so it goes by courier — and no courier is connected (set DELHIVERY_API_TOKEN, the EKART_ variables, the SHIPROCKET_ variables or VELOCITY_API_KEY). Customers see "not available right now" and can't pay.
checkoutDelivery.notMeasured: Only you see this. An item in this cart has no packing measurements, so the courier can't price the parcel. Delivery settings lists which item and where to add them.

vendorPickup.heading: Shelf rack vendor pickup
vendorPickup.hint: Shelf racks always ship straight from their maker, so checkout prices them from this address. Everything else ships from our pickup. Until a vendor is chosen, shelf racks are priced from our pickup too.
vendorPickup.saved: Saved. Checkout prices shelf racks from here from now on.
vendorPickup.vendorAdded: Vendor added. Pick it above and save.

errors.noSettings: Save admin → delivery first — our pickup address is needed before vendors.
errors.vendorMissing: That vendor was removed. Choose another.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Every paid weekly plan, what each coming Saturday adds up to in trays, and the rotation behind it. One bundle is one box a Saturday for four Saturdays; a box's grams are split evenly across that week's varieties.
subscriptions.statOpenHint: The Friday-night cutoff for the next open Saturday
subscriptions.trayPlanIntro: Grams of each variety every paid box adds up to, per Saturday. Trays are at the variety's low yield, so a light tray still fills every box; the figure in brackets is the high yield. Sow by is the Saturday less the grow days.
subscriptions.emptyWeekWarning: {plans}: week {n} has no varieties set, so these boxes have nothing to sow. Set week {n} on admin → plans.
subscriptions.inBoxes: in {count, plural, one {# box} other {# boxes}}
subscriptions.rotationIntro: Every subscriber gets the same week on the same Saturday, so someone joining mid-month starts on whichever week comes next. Per-variety grams are the box weight split evenly.
subscriptions.noPlans: No active plan is priced by the month yet.
subscriptions.boxesPerWeek: {count, plural, one {# box} other {# boxes}} a week

detail.saturdaysIntro: Skipping a Saturday moves that box to the end of the term, so the customer still gets every box they paid for. Saturdays already sown for are marked; skipping one of those leaves its trays spare.

skip.label: Skip
skip.title: Skip {date}?
skip.confirm: No box goes out that Saturday. One more Saturday is added after {last}, on whichever week of the rotation it falls, so the customer still gets every box.

pause.label: Pause
pause.title: Pause this subscription?
pause.confirm: {count, plural, one {The # Saturday still to come comes} other {The # Saturdays still to come come}} off the calendar and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} held until you resume. Nothing goes out while it is paused.

detail.paused: Paused with {count, plural, one {# Saturday} other {# Saturdays}} held.

resume.label: Resume
resume.hint: Held Saturdays go back on the calendar from {date}, the first Saturday still open.

cancelSub.label: Cancel subscription
cancelSub.title: Cancel this subscription?
cancelSub.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is left to deliver.} one {# Saturday is left undelivered ({boxes, plural, one {# box} other {# boxes}}).} other {# Saturdays are left undelivered ({boxes, plural, one {# box} other {# boxes}}).}} They come off the calendar and the customer sees “Cancelled”. Refund what you owe them in the {gateway} dashboard.

detail.cancelledNote: Cancelled. Any refund is made in the {gateway} dashboard.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Everyone who has signed in, most recent buyer first. Open one to see their orders, plans and addresses.

sowing.title: Sowing log
sowing.intro: What you sowed each day, and what it gave at harvest. Add a sowing on the day you sow it — one row per variety — then come back to its card when you cut and record the grams. Yield is harvest grams per gram of seed, so a heavy sowing and a light one compare fairly. Saving a sowing takes its seed grams off the seed shelf; editing it moves the difference, and deleting it puts them back.
sowing.newHint: Pick the date, then add a row for each variety sown that day. Trays are optional, but with them you also get grams per tray.
sowing.noVarieties: No varieties yet. Add them on admin → varieties first; a sowing is picked from that list.
sowing.harvestHint: Leave the harvest blank while a variety is still growing. A harvest with no date is recorded as cut today. Zero is fine — it records a tray that failed.
sowing.savedNew: Saved — it is at the top of the log below.
sowing.cardSummary: {lines, plural, one {# variety} other {# varieties}} · {grams, number} g seed · {harvested, plural, =0 {nothing harvested yet} other {# harvested}}
sowing.summaryHint: Every sowing added up. Seed sown counts everything; harvest, yield and days count only what has been cut, so a crop still growing does not drag the yield down. The small figures are what admin → varieties has set, for comparison.
sowing.empty: No sowings yet. Add the first one above.
sowing.deleteConfirm: The sowing on {date} and every harvest recorded on it will be removed, and the seed it took goes back on the shelf. This cannot be undone.

errors.dateFuture: That date is in the future.
errors.noLines: Add at least one variety with its seed grams.
errors.seedInvalid: Row {row}: seed grams must be above zero.
errors.traysInvalid: Row {row}: trays must be a whole number, 1 or more — or leave it blank.
errors.harvestInvalid: Row {row}: harvest grams must be zero or more.
errors.harvestDateInvalid: Row {row}: pick a real harvest date.
errors.harvestBeforeSow: Row {row}: the harvest date is before the sowing.
errors.harvestDateWithoutGrams: Row {row}: a harvest date needs the grams harvested.
errors.notFound: This sowing no longer exists — reload the page.

notices.seedShort: Saved, but the seed shelf had less {seeds} than this sowing used, so it now shows none. Count it and correct it on the seeds screen.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.intro: Everyone we buy from. A purchase bill picks its vendor from here. A registered vendor's GSTIN sets their state, which decides whether their bills carry CGST + SGST or IGST.
vendors.empty: No vendors yet. Add the first one above, then enter their bills on Purchases.
vendors.name: Name

kindHint.registered: Their bill shows their GSTIN, and its GST can be claimed.
kindHint.unregistered: Their bill carries no GST, so there is nothing to claim.
kindHint.foreign: A foreign service such as Cloudflare. We pay the GST ourselves under reverse charge.

vendors.gstinHint: 15 characters, exactly as on their bill. Their state is read from the first two digits.
vendors.filingHint: GST portal → Search Taxpayer → their GSTIN → Show filing table.
vendors.billCount: {count, plural, =0 {No bills yet} one {# bill} other {# bills}}
vendors.deleteConfirm: {name} has no bills, so nothing else changes.

errors.gstinInvalid: That GSTIN doesn't check out. Compare all 15 characters with their bill.
errors.notFound: That vendor no longer exists. Reload the page.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.intro: Every vendor bill, with where its GST credit stands. Enter a bill when it arrives. Stock you buy to sell goes straight onto the shelf, and the bill sets its cost. The credit is claimed once the vendor's own return puts it in your GSTR-2B.
purchases.newHint: Copy the bill as it is printed. The GST is worked out from each line's value and rate, and you can type over it to match the bill to the paisa.

vendorKind.registered: Registered — their GST can be claimed.
vendorKind.unregistered: Not registered — their bill carries no GST.
vendorKind.foreign: Outside India — we pay the GST under reverse charge.

purchases.numberHint: Exactly as printed. It is how the bill is matched to GSTR-2B.
purchases.paidOnHint: Leave empty until paid. Credit has to be reversed if a bill is unpaid 180 days after its date.
purchases.reverseCharge: We pay this bill's GST (reverse charge)
purchases.reverseChargeHint: Only for services where the law puts the tax on the buyer. Most bills are not.
purchases.foreignNote: A foreign vendor charges no Indian GST. Enter the value in rupees and the rate (usually 18%). The tax becomes ours to pay, and to claim back.
purchases.unregisteredNote: This vendor is not registered, so the bill carries no GST and nothing is claimed.
purchases.vendorFirst: Choose the vendor first: a stock line offers only what they supply.
purchases.suppliesNothing: {vendor} isn't set to supply any product yet. Add one with "+ New product…", or tick {vendor} on the product's own screen.
purchases.taxHint: The grey figure is the GST worked out from the value and rate. Leave it, or type the bill's own figure if it differs by a few paise. Credit: Full for things bought to resell; Shared for costs that serve every sale (courier, packaging, software), where the exempt share is reversed each period; None for anything used only to grow greens, because microgreens and seeds are exempt.
purchases.fileHint: PDF or photo, up to 3 MB.
purchases.waitingNote: {count, plural, one {# bill is} other {# bills are}} not in a GSTR-2B yet — the vendor hasn't filed it.
purchases.payByNote: {vendor}, bill {number}: pay by {date}, or its credit has to be reversed.
purchases.empty: No bills yet. Enter the first one when it arrives.
purchases.portalMatched: In the {month} GSTR-2B as billed: {taxable} + {tax} GST.
purchases.portalMismatch: In the {month} GSTR-2B, but differently: {taxable} + {tax} GST. Check with the vendor, or correct the bill if you typed it wrong.
purchases.lockedNote: This bill is claimed in a quarter whose GSTR-3B is filed, so it can no longer change. Put any correction in the next open month.
purchases.claimHint: For a bill that is in the portal's GSTR-2B but the upload couldn't match, usually because the vendor typed the number differently. Choose the month whose GSTR-2B shows it.
purchases.deleteConfirm: Bill {number} from {vendor} goes. Any stock it added comes back off the shelf, and any cost it set goes back to the one before.

errors.numberRequired: Enter the bill number as printed.
errors.numberTooLong: That bill number is too long.
errors.dateFuture: That date is in the future.
errors.categoryRequired: Line {row}: choose what it was for.
errors.itemRequired: Line {row}: choose which item it adds to.
errors.itemNotSupplied: Line {row}: {vendor} isn't set to supply that item. Tick them on its product screen first, or add it with "+ New product…".
errors.quantityInvalid: Line {row}: enter a whole quantity — packs, blocks or grams.
errors.descriptionRequired: Line {row}: describe it as the bill does.
errors.taxableInvalid: Line {row}: enter the value before GST.
errors.taxOff: Line {row}: that GST is more than a rupee away from the value × rate. Check the figure.
errors.creditRequired: Line {row}: choose how much credit it gives.
errors.tooManyLines: That's more lines than one bill can hold here — split it.
errors.notFound: That bill no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.locked: This bill is in a filed quarter and can't change.
errors.fileType: The file must be a PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.fileTooBig: The file is over 3 MB. Save it smaller or as a PDF.
errors.reverseChargeClaim: Reverse-charge credit is claimed in the bill's own month, automatically.
errors.monthInvalid: Choose a month from the bill's month up to this one.
errors.notClaimable: This bill has no GST to claim.

purchases.freightHint: Shared across this bill's stock lines by value and added to their cost. Its credit follows the goods: None on seed, Full on trays and cocopeat.
purchases.costPreview: Sets its cost to {amount, number, ::currency/INR} per {unit}, GST and shipping included

newItem.title: New product
newItem.hint: Adds it to its product screen, hidden. This bill sets its cost and stock when you save it; it goes on sale once its content file exists and you switch it on.
newItem.keyHint: Lowercase letters and hyphens. It names content/{folder}/[key].json, so it is an identifier, not a label.

errors.kindInvalid: Pick what kind of product it is.
errors.keyRequired: Give it a key, like sunflower or tray-pair.
errors.keyInvalid: Lowercase letters and hyphens only — no numbers or spaces.
errors.keyTaken: “{key}” already exists. If it isn't in this vendor's list, tick them on its product screen first.

gst.title: GST returns
gst.intro: Your GST, a quarter at a time: what you sold and bought each month, what to pay by the 25th, every GSTR-1 table and GSTR-3B box, and the GSTR-2B match. Nothing is sent to the portal from here. Type the figures across, or import the CSVs into the Offline Tool.
gst.lockedNote: This quarter's GSTR-3B is marked filed, so nothing in it changes here. Undo that on Filing if it was a mistake.

summary.salesHint: What customers paid, by invoice date, net of credit notes. Microgreens, plans and seeds are exempt; trays, cocopeat and racks carry GST.
summary.purchasesHint: Bills by bill date. Credit counts in the month its GSTR-2B shows it, which can be later.
summary.positionHint: Credit carried in, plus this quarter's credit, against the tax on sales. Reverse-charge tax is always paid in cash.

payments.intro: Quarterly filers pay monthly. For the first two months of a quarter, pay by the 25th with PMT-06 (Services → Payments → Create Challan → Monthly payment for quarterly taxpayer). This works it out by self-assessment: tax on the quarter's sales so far, less the credit in your GSTR-2B, less what you have already deposited. Month three is paid with GSTR-3B.
payments.fixedSum: Fixed-sum alternative: the portal's pre-filled PMT-06 would be about {amount} a month (35% of last quarter's cash). Self-assessment is usually less for you, because stock purchases leave spare credit.
payments.settled: Nothing left to pay for this month.
payments.toPayHint: Pay this with PMT-06, then record the challan below.
payments.inProgress: Month in progress — the figure grows as you sell and shrinks as credit arrives.
payments.taxSoFar: Tax on sales, quarter so far
payments.quarterTitle: Quarter balance — pay with GSTR-3B by {date}
payments.quarterHint: Everything the quarter needs in cash, less every deposit made in it. Create a challan for the balance before filing GSTR-3B.
payments.recordHint: Once a challan is paid on the portal, record it here so the next figure counts it. Use the CPIN or CIN from the challan.
payments.notYet: Payments can be recorded once the quarter has begun.
payments.deleteConfirm: The record of challan {reference} goes. The money stays deposited on the portal.

gstr1.intro: GSTR-1 lists the quarter's sales table by table. Each section has the Offline Tool's CSV: import it there, generate the JSON, and upload that on the portal. Or type these figures into the portal directly.
gstr1.unplacedTitle: {count, plural, one {# sale has} other {# sales have}} no place of supply — the portal needs one. Open each and set the state:
gstr1.b2bHint: One entry per invoice, from buyers who gave a GSTIN at checkout. Only the taxable lines; their exempt lines are in table 8.
gstr1.b2clHint: Consumer invoices over ₹1 lakh delivered to another state.
gstr1.b2csHint: Every other consumer sale, summed by state and rate. Credit notes are netted in here.
gstr1.nilHint: Microgreens, plans and seeds, by inter- or intra-state and registered or unregistered buyer.
gstr1.notesHint: Only credit notes against B2B or B2CL invoices go here. Consumer credit notes are netted in tables 7 and 8.
gstr1.hsnHint: Every sale by HSN code and rate, in separate B2B and B2C tabs on the portal. Delivery charges sit under the code of the goods they carried.
gstr1.docsHint: The first and last invoice and credit-note numbers of the quarter.
gstr1.csvNote: The CSVs follow the Offline Tool's own templates. A place of supply is written as "29-Karnataka"; if the tool rejects one for Jammu and Kashmir, Andaman and Nicobar Islands or Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, pick the state from its list instead.

gstr3b.intro: GSTR-3B box by box. The portal fills 3.1 and 3.2 from GSTR-1 and won't let you edit them, so check them against these. Type table 4 in yourself, then pay what 6.1 leaves in cash.
gstr3b.t31Title: 3.1 Outward supplies and inward supplies on reverse charge
gstr3b.t32Hint: The out-of-state part of 3.1(a) sold to consumers, by state.
gstr3b.t4Hint: Credit from bills claimed in this quarter's GSTR-2Bs. The whole of it goes in 4A; 4B(1) takes back what Rule 42 says exempt sales used.
gstr3b.t4a3: 4A(3) Inward supplies liable to reverse charge (other than imports)
gstr3b.rule42: Exempt sales {exempt} of total sales {total} = {share}%. That share of the {common} credit on shared costs is reversed ({reversed}), plus all {exclusive} of the credit on things used only for growing greens.
gstr3b.rule42Note: Rule 42 is recalculated for the whole year by the September return, so a small correction can come then.
gstr3b.t5Title: 5 Exempt, nil-rated and non-GST inward supplies
gstr3b.t5exempt: From a supplier under composition, exempt and nil-rated (seeds)
gstr3b.t61Hint: Credit pays tax in the order the law sets: IGST credit first, and CGST and SGST credit never pay each other. Whatever is left is paid in cash.
gstr3b.head: Tax

match.uploadHint: On the portal: Returns → GSTR-2B → choose the month → Download JSON. Upload each month's, and the quarter's when it comes. Bills that match are claimed in that month.
match.noStatements: No GSTR-2B uploaded for this quarter yet.
match.claimedHint: Bills whose credit counts in this quarter's GSTR-3B.
match.mismatchHint: The vendor's return has the bill, but with different amounts. Correct your entry if you typed it wrong, or ask the vendor to amend theirs. Claim it by hand once the amounts agree.
match.waitingHint: Bills in your register that no GSTR-2B shows yet. Their credit moves to the month the vendor files. Chase any that have waited more than a quarter.
match.unknownTitle: On the portal, not in your register
match.unknownHint: Bills a vendor reported against your GSTIN that aren't entered here. Enter them on Purchases, or reject them in IMS if they aren't yours.

filing.checksHint: The return can be filed with any of these open, but each is a figure that will be wrong or late.
filing.okPlaced: Every sale has a place of supply.
filing.checkPlaced: {count, plural, one {# sale has} other {# sales have}} no place of supply — set it on GSTR-1.
filing.okMismatch: No bill disagrees with its vendor's return.
filing.checkMismatch: {count, plural, one {# bill disagrees} other {# bills disagree}} with the vendor's return — see Credit match.
filing.okWaiting: Every bill from the quarter is in a GSTR-2B.
filing.checkWaiting: {count, plural, one {# bill is} other {# bills are}} still waiting for the vendor. Their credit moves to a later quarter.
filing.gstr1Hint: File it on the portal with the OTP, then record the ARN it gives you.
filing.gstr3bHint: Recording GSTR-3B closes the quarter: its ledgers carry into the next one, and its bills and payments stop changing.
filing.undo1: Only the record here changes. The return stays filed on the portal.
filing.undo3b: The quarter reopens here, and its closing balances are worked out again. The return stays filed on the portal.

errors.fileTooBig: That file is larger than a GSTR-2B should be.
errors.notJson: That isn't a JSON file. Download the JSON, not the Excel.
errors.notGstr2b: That JSON isn't a GSTR-2B. Download it from Returns → GSTR-2B.
errors.wrongGstin: That GSTR-2B is for {gstin}, not for Fewgrams.
errors.locked: That month's quarter is filed and closed.
errors.monthInvalid: Choose a month of this quarter that has begun.
errors.dateInvalid: Enter a valid date, not in the future.
errors.referenceRequired: Enter the challan's CPIN or CIN.
errors.amountRequired: Enter the amount paid in at least one head.
errors.quarterInvalid: Something went wrong. Reload the page.
errors.arnRequired: Enter the ARN the portal gave you.

suppliers.title: Vendors for {item}
suppliers.hint: Tick everyone you buy this from. Only their purchase bills offer it.
suppliers.noVendors: No vendors yet — add the first one.

errors.badKey: That product can't take a vendor. Reload the page.
errors.unknownVendor: A vendor in the list no longer exists. Reload the page.
